name: idd-baseline-suite
description: Nuxt replication of the IDD paper's baseline diagnostic arms: classical PCA monitoring (Chiang 2001/Qin 2012), FaultExplainer-protocol replication (PCA(0.9)+T2+EXPLAIN_ROOT), and the same-model bare-LLM single-call protocol. Runs real diagnoses on the IDD benchmark scenarios' prepared data. Truth-free by contract: no truth, no keywords, no gradings are read.
